title: HAAYE SYEDA ZAINAB
body:
HAAYE SYEDA ZAINAB HAAYE SYEDA ZAINAB
JAAN-E-KARBALA ZAINAB HAAYE SYEDA ZAINAB
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Jin-o-Ins Rotey Hai Kheke Jaan Khote Hai
Wa Musibata Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
2.Baniye Aza Zainab Pheli Zakira Zainab
<<MINI>>
Haaye Syeda Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Kya Kya Hadesey Guzrey Pusht Par Laagey Durrey
<<MINI>>
Ruh-e-Fatima Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Deen Ko Tu Rida De Di Bhai Par Fida Kardi
Apne Nounehaal Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
5.Raat Ke Aandhere Me Dushmanou Ke Gherey Me
Dhudhti Hai Kya Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Julm-o-Jor Sehne Ki Ibteda Toh Maa Ne Ki
Tu Hai Inteha Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
7.Bailchey Se Zalim Ne War Hai Kiya Kaisa
Kargayi Qaaza Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Kitne Rah Me Bichdhe Kitne Hadesey Guzrey
<<MINI>>
Tu Ne Sehliya Zainab Haaye Syeda Zainab
